research_scope: Null race_restriction CaC-usable skills, five-record follow-up.

records.name: Super Explosive Wave (Evasive)
records.evidence: Repository reconciliation identifies this as a CaC-usable Evasive; external reference material explicitly describes the Super Explosive Wave skill as usable by all races. This supports unrestricted eligibility rather than a narrower race restriction.

records.name: Super Galick Gun
records.evidence: The Future Warrior technique reference lists Super Galick Gun among Future Warrior techniques. Its association with Super Saiyan Blue Vegeta is character/form context, not evidence that CaCs must be Saiyan; no explicit CaC race/gender restriction was found.

records.name: Super Ghost Kamikaze Attack (Super)
records.evidence: Direct skill reference identifies Gotenks as a notable user and training with Gotenks as the unlock route, while the broader technique reference explicitly states the Future Warrior can learn the Super version. No narrower CaC race/gender/form condition is established.

records.name: Super Ki Explosion
records.evidence: Direct skill reference shows Skill Shop acquisition and broad customizable-partner availability; the Dragon Ball reference lists Future Warrior as a user. No explicit CaC race/gender restriction is established, so null is retained.

records.name: Super Mad Dance
records.evidence: Direct reference identifies Skill Shop acquisition and Future Warrior use. Its Gogeta association is character context only; no explicit CaC race/gender/form restriction was found.

policy: Only explicit CaC eligibility wording establishing a narrower race/gender/form condition can populate race_restriction; preserve null otherwise.
